entries.name: 青瓦门楣
entries.brief: Completely redesign header as a compact ancient Jiangnan market gateway: a slim gently upturned charcoal-blue tiled eave across the top, a shallow warm timber lintel with the red five-character brand inset into a cream gold-edged central panel. The roof is thin and refined, not another red-and-white awning. Two small glowing red lanterns hang directly beneath roof ends. Integrated tiny chapter text on bottom lip of central panel. Sound/settings tuck into upper left wood corners; wallet right below reserved capsule space. Symmetric, low-height, strongly architectural and cohesive, with deep blue sky breathing room before the red stall canopy. Distinct from a loose hanging curved logo with very long ropes, and distinct from the failed simple straight wooden beam.

entries.name: 单侧店幌
entries.brief: Completely redesign header with asymmetry inspired by a traditional shop's hanging side banner. A beautiful cream woven vertical shop banner hangs at upper LEFT, on a short bamboo rod with refined red binding; five red Chinese brand characters 灯火大排档 form a readable bold calligraphic vertical composition, and tiny chapter text is integrated along its lower edge. Use upper RIGHT as airy dark blue night sky framed by a loose curved string of warm festoon bulbs and one modest red paper lantern, not a mirrored pair. Two utilities discreetly at top-left above banner, wallet top-right below reserved system space. The banner should be compact, warm and hand-crafted, never a huge modern rectangular sidebar, and must not obstruct the centered stall below. This is a cohesive asymmetrical alternative to centered plaques.

entries.name: 夜空题字
entries.brief: Completely redesign header WITHOUT any physical large wooden plaque, beam, roof or cloth banner: place the five Chinese brand characters 灯火大排档 in beautiful bold warm ivory-gold brush lettering directly on a rich deep teal blue night sky, elegantly centered with gentle embossed gold depth and restrained warm shadow. Small chapter text integrated closely under the title, not a separate toolbar. A graceful swoop of tiny warm festoon lights arcs behind the lettering near the top; a little bamboo foliage comes from one upper corner and a small lantern cluster balances the opposite corner, framing generous sky. Utilities small at upper left, wallet upper right below reserved system space. Refined Chinese cozy market title treatment, strong hierarchy and breathable composition, not flat generic sans-serif and not neon/cyberpunk.

entries.name: 米布横幌
entries.brief: Completely redesign header as a warm tactile horizontal cream linen shop hanging, a gracefully curved soft woven fabric banner suspended between two small bamboo pegs, with folded red stitched corners and tiny decorative red knots. The five red Chinese brand characters 灯火大排档 are beautifully brush-painted on the cream fabric; tiny chapter text lives within its lower hem. The shape is a single simple broad fabric swathe, not a canopy with scallops or stripes, not a wood sign, not a giant card. A few glowing warm bulbs float in background sky with dark foliage and distant rooftops. Sound/settings at upper left, wallet upper right under reserved capsule space. Fresh relaxed domestic street-food personality, cream textile, honey wood and vermilion, visually cozy and polished. Leave real sky separation between this textile sign and the red stall canopy below.
